uncovered_waiver.reason: OMN-21536 flips the node to canonical def-B by changing handle() to take one typed request (correlation id read from the request); the private helpers that hold the business logic are re-derived byte-identical base_ref<->HEAD by the ratchet from git. Equivalence rests on that git-verbatim preservation plus the executed parity tests, not on a broad branch-coverage claim: the scenario pool drives this node's representative handler only, and the remaining handlers' error branches are covered by the node's existing unit suite.
